owner_order: очисти все диалоги предыдущие в веб приложении и на компе о моих тестовых разговорах, дальше только production version
privacy: No message body, title, attachment name or memory content was read, printed or logged. Content was handled as opaque bytes (files) and vault-sealed values (companion rows, never decrypted). Only ids, counts, hashes and statuses were looked at.

archive.encryption: Windows DPAPI CryptProtectData, CurrentUser scope, optional entropy b'bossman-chat-cleanup-20261025', header 'BCDPAPI1\n'; payload = JSON bundle
archive.manifest: archive-manifest.json (local only; per-file sha256 of the archived sources)
archive.restore: CryptUnprotectData with the same entropy as the same Windows user -> JSON -> write files back (base64) / INSERT rows back (bodies are still companion-vault-sealed)

stores.store: command-center-chat (web app :8801 + mobile pult :8840 + bossman chat CLI + /api/agent/sessions; one history)
stores.archive_verified: decrypted back: same counts, every file sha256 identical to source
stores.method: 44 x DELETE /api/chat/threads/{id}?purge=1&confirm={id} (official API; removes <id>.json, <id>.json.bak, threads-meta entry) -> 44 purged, 0 errors, 0 skipped (each live file re-hashed against the archive first); agent-sessions-meta/agent-compact entries of purged ids removed (no API); chat\attachments folders removed; terminal\history.txt removed

one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction: DELETE history/learning_log WHERE who=owner; DELETE inbox WHERE who=owner AND phase NOT IN (pending,processing); DELETE state keys agent_session:claude/codex and claude_session for the owner (Claude/Codex bridge conversation pointers)

mobile_pult_own_store: none: bossmobile proxies chat to :8801 (/m/api/threads -> /api/chat/threads); its data dir holds only pairing token + phone sessions

kept_intentionally.jeff_participant_data: bcc.pit / CommandCenter\pit-v1.7 (incl. its own companion.sqlite3) not touched: other people's data

tasks_and_receipts.note: evidence, kept; chat turns' prompts and answers are stored in these tasks, so the task list still shows them; the 258th task is the synthetic e2e test

companion_owner_profile.note: learned profile/settings, not raw history; /forget in the pult clears it

companion_proposals.note: task delegation bindings used by STOP/owns_task; kept

kept_intentionally.logs: backend/companion log files may contain fragments of conversations; not touched (not a dialog store)
kept_intentionally.claude_code_transcripts: the Claude/Codex bridge sessions themselves (outside Bossman data) were not touched; only Bossman's pointers to them were reset

verification_after.restarts: none (backend, pult and companion kept running)
